blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The matched USDAWithPremium source defines addToBlacklist(address) and removeFromBlacklist(address), both restricted by onlyDefaultAdmin, and enforces BLACKLIST on transfer paths. At BSC block 125055866, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x14170c3332ccd96859c8fb5754a753e476d09751) returned true. This is explicit token-level censorship, independent of the undisclosed reserve backing.
